purpose: Prevent A2/A3 from becoming passive evaluation-only stages. Every material weakness must produce a bounded causal repair candidate, which is revalidated through the required upstream gates before any new improvement claim.

objective.selection_rule: Prefer strict Pareto improvement. A child that improves one cosmetic metric while degrading expectancy/PF/DD materially is rejected. Improvements must survive realistic costs and fresh validation.

A2_improvement_axes.mechanism: Suppress redundant same-direction re-entry clusters without deleting trades after outcomes are known.
Require forecast/gross edge margin to exceed frozen round-trip cost plus a preregistered safety buffer using only entry-time observable information.
Scale exposure by ex-ante realized volatility while preserving signal identity; do not optimize after observing outcomes.
Use native, source-quality-verified funding/basis/OI only when the holding horizon crosses funding or leverage demand materially changes expected net edge.
Use a preregistered persistence/continuation confirmation only when evidence indicates false-break/reversal cost dominates; any delayed entry is a new child and must restart A1 controls.
Compare frozen causal exits such as volatility trail, state-transition exit, or time-decay exit against the canonical parent without parameter sweeps.

A3_improvement_axes.mechanism: Reduce risk in empirically fragile high-vol/panic states using ex-ante volatility; do not delete historical losing trades post hoc.
If long/short payoffs are structurally asymmetric, test explicit long-only or asymmetric-risk children on the exact canonical parent rather than silently mixing derived lineages.
Normalize risk across BTC/ETH or other admitted symbols so one symbol cannot dominate profit merely because of volatility/notional scale.
Test documented crypto hour/session liquidity-volatility periodicity with fixed entry-time observable clock states; no post-hoc best-session selection.
When source readiness exists, use spread/depth/order-flow information to distinguish durable continuation from adverse-selection entries.
Require agreement between preregistered fast/slow trend states rather than optimizing a single lookback; test as a new exact-parent child.

fresh prospective confirmation before final survivor tiering
